sections.overview: Kumar Kalyan Ras – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage
sections.introduction: Kumar Kalyan Ras is an herbal-mineral ayurvedic formulation that is known to have the mixture of herbs and mineral like mercury. This is known to treat paediatric and heart related ailments.
sections.ingredients:
Kumari Rasa – Aloe vera’s juice extract 
 Shuddha Parada – Purified Mercury 
 Abhraka Bhasma – Purified and processed Mica 
 Mukta Bhasma – Bhasma (Calx) of Pearl 
 Loha Bhasma – Bhasma prepared from Iron 
 Swarna Bhasma – Bhasma of Gold 
 Makshika Bhasma – Bhasma of Copper – Iron Pyrite 

 Method of Preparation 

 Take the ingredients number 2 to 7 up to 10 grams and powder them. 
 Now ground the powdered mixture with aloe vera juice extract to make their paste. 
 Now take the paste up to 62.5 mg and make their pills.
sections.dose: One pill, one to two times a day, before or after meals, with milk, honey or sugar.
sections.indications:
Paediatric ailments like:- 

 Fever 
 Asthma 
 Jaundice 
 Cough 
 Emaciation 
 Indigestion 
 Vomiting 
 Digestive power
sections.contraindications:
Take the medicine under doctor’s prescription. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Kumar Kalyan Ras – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference – Bhaishajya Ratnavali, Bala Rogadhikara. 
 Introduction 
 Kumar Kalyan Ras is an herbal-mineral ayurvedic formulation that is known to have the mixture of herbs and mineral like mercury. This is known to treat paediatric and heart related ailments. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Kumari Rasa – Aloe vera’s juice extract 
 Shuddha Parada – Purified Mercury 
 Abhraka Bhasma – Purified and processed Mica 
 Mukta Bhasma – Bhasma (Calx) of Pearl 
 Loha Bhasma – Bhasma prepared from Iron 
 Swarna Bhasma – Bhasma of Gold 
 Makshika Bhasma – Bhasma of Copper – Iron Pyrite 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 
 Take the ingredients number 2 to 7 up to 10 grams and powder them. 
 Now ground the powdered mixture with aloe vera juice extract to make their paste. 
 Now take the paste up to 62.5 mg and make their pills. 
 
 Dose 
 One pill, one to two times a day, before or after meals, with milk, honey or sugar. 
 Indications 
 Paediatric ailments like:- 
 
 Fever 
 Asthma 
 Jaundice 
 Cough 
 Emaciation 
 Indigestion 
 Vomiting 
 Digestive power 
 
 Contraindications 
 Take the medicine under doctor’s prescription. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
